{"parentUuid":"6d08fbe7-b690-4ee6-87e5-71e2f27fbb97","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"ffbb8a8a-4bb8-4c99-a79e-9ed4dd97a041","agentId":"afc68b33f10efb8e1","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"<command-message>crucible</command-message>\n<command-name>crucible</command-name>\n<skill-format>true</skill-format>"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main/.claude/skills/crucible\n\n# CRUCIBLE — operating the engine\n\nCRUCIBLE turns an authorized seed URL into **oracle-confirmed** findings, reasons over them,\nand produces auditable reports — inside a fail-closed safety stack. Its whole value is one\nrule; internalize it before anything else:\n\n> **A claim is a FACT only when a deterministic oracle fires over data a real target\n> produced.** You (the LLM) ADVISE where to look and what a result might mean; the oracle\n> CONFIRMS. Nothing else — not your confidence, not a critic's endorsement, not a plausible\n> story — promotes a claim to a fact.\n\nThe standing doctrine every reasoning call operates under is\n[framework/cognitive/metacognition.md](../../../framework/cognitive/metacognition.md) (it is\ninjected into every LLM system prompt). The full architecture — agents, event spine, veracity\nlayer, learning/metacognition core, safety stack — is\n[framework/v2/docs/CRUCIBLE-AI.md](../../../framework/v2/docs/CRUCIBLE-AI.md). The binding\nconstitution is [CLAUDE.md](../../../CLAUDE.md); never relax scope, destruction, evidence, or\nhonesty rules.\n\n## The invariants (never violate these)\n\n1. **Oracle authority.** Only a fired oracle confirms. Critics/RL/reflection/self-consistency\n   may only *advise, re-rank, defer, or abstain* — never promote a finding or override the oracle.\n2. **Coverage.** Never silently skip an authorized attack surface. Learning and reflection\n   *deprioritise* (re-rank / defer); they never gate a surface out.\n3. **Prove by re-execution.** A finding is a fact only if its retained `oracle_context`\n   re-fires. The veracity firewall (`framework/v2/veracity/`) re-runs proofs; it can only demote.\n4. **Non-circular learning.** An EXPLOITABLE label needs ≥2 independent corroborating oracle\n   kinds; a silent oracle is never auto-labelled a false positive.\n5. **Refuse honestly, fail closed.** Decline to conclude what you cannot ground; record every\n   refusal as evidence. Hard limits (scope, authorization, destruction, real user data) are\n   inviolable — when unsure, stop and ask.\n6. **Determinism + append-only.** No wallclock/global-rng in learning/reward math; the event\n   spine is append-only (supersede, never edit).\n\n## Structured workflows\n\n### Run an authorized engagement (end-to-end, gated)\n1. Confirm the active target's `targets/<slug>/charter.md` authorizes it (constitution §II).\n2. `python3 -m framework.v2 engage <slug> <seed-url> [--recon] [--spine]`\n   — crawls, audits, confirms via oracles, chains attack paths, scores confidence, and\n   (with `--spine`) mirrors the whole run onto the immutable blackboard event stream.\n   (`--strict-evidence` is a **`scan`**-only flag, below — not an `engage` flag.)\n3. Every request passes the full gate chain; an out-of-scope seed or tripped kill-switch\n   refuses *before* traffic and is recorded as a `refusal` event.\n\n### Loopback-only quick scan\n`python3 -m framework.v2 scan http://127.0.0.1:<port>/ --format json|sarif|html [--strict-evidence]`\n— the export states each finding's **live grounding** (fact / ungrounded / contradicted);\n`--strict-evidence` withholds non-fact findings from the rendered doc but keeps them in\n`--reverifiable-out`.\n\n### Re-verify a report (prove-don't-guess, offline)\n`python3 -m framework.v2 verify <report.json>` re-runs each finding's retained `oracle_context`.\n`python3 -m framework.v2 evidence ...` builds/verifies signed, hash-linked evidence certificates\n(and, with report claims bound in, fails closed when a report sentence has no backing evidence).\n\n### Inspect / audit the event spine\nThe blackboard (`framework/v2/agents/blackboard.py`) is the one append-only, typed, provenance-\nlinked event stream. Replay it with `Blackboard.replay(engagement=..., since_id=...)`.\nCryptographic tamper-evidence: `framework/v2/agents/spine_chain.py`\n(`build_spine_chain` / `sign_spine_head` / `verify_spine_head`).\n\n### Recon / intel, memory, self-improvement\n`python3 -m framework.v2 intel ...` (OSINT into the shared world-model; gated egress),\n`memory ...` (cross-engagement priors — never fabricate a score), `improve ...`\n(authorise-not-apply — it never self-applies a change).\n\n### Read-only operator console\n`python3 -m framework.v2 console` — loopback, read-only, zero-impact operator UI over the run.\n\n## What NOT to do\n- Do not build detection-evasion / identity-rotation / stay-hidden-from-defenders capability —\n  CRUCIBLE is correlatable and authorized by doctrine (constitution §VI).\n- Do not let any learned/critic/LLM signal enter the deterministic oracle/SCE/calibration inputs\n  or promote a finding.\n- Do not attack third parties (payment/IdP/CDN) — test only the operator's integration with them.\n"}]},"isMeta":true,"uuid":"beeebc79-6816-4325-84c8-835491340e33","timestamp":"2026-07-18T18:05:11.299Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Mirrors `consolidate.extract.LocalProvider`.\"\"\"\n44\t    def __init__(self, model: str = \"moondream\", host: Optional[str] = None, timeout: int = 60):\n45\t        self.model = model\n46\t        self.host = host or os.environ.get(\"OLLAMA_HOST\") or \"http://127.0.0.1:11434\"\n47\t        self.timeout = timeout\n48\t\n49\t    def describe(self, frame: Frame, question: str) -> str:\n50\t        b64 = _b64_image(frame)\n51\t        if b64 is None:\n52\t            return \"\"\n53\t        body = json.dumps({\"model\": self.model, \"prompt\": (question or \"Describe what is visible.\"),\n54\t                           \"images\": [b64], \"stream\": False}).encode(\"utf-8\")\n55\t        req = urllib.request.Request(f\"{self.host.rstrip('/')}/api/generate\", data=body, method=\"POST\",\n56\t                                     headers={\"content-type\": \"application/json\"})\n57\t        try:\n58\t            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=self.timeout) as resp:\n59\t                payload = json.loads(resp.read().decode(\"utf-8\"))\n60\t        except (urllib.error.URLError, OSError, ValueError):\n61\t            return \"\"   # no reading (honest empty), never a fabricated one\n62\t        return str(payload.get(\"response\", \"\")).strip()[:2000]\n63\t\n64\t\n65\tclass ClaudeVision:\n66\t    \"\"\"FRONTIER Anthropic vision API — `describe()` UPLOADS the image (data egress). Gate it via\n67\t    `perception.egress`; do not call directly on an auto path. Mirrors `extract.ApiProvider`.\"\"\"\n68\t    def __init__(self, model: str = \"claude-sonnet-5\", api_key: Optional[str] = None,\n69\t                 timeout: int = 60, max_tokens: int = 512):\n70\t        self.model = model\n71\t        self.api_key = api_key or os.environ.get(\"SIGIL_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY\") or os.environ.get(\"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY\")\n72\t        self.timeout = timeout\n73\t        self.max_tokens = max_tokens\n74\t\n75\t    def describe(self, frame: Frame, question: str) -> str:\n76\t        b64 = _b64_image(frame)\n77\t        if b64 is None or not self.api_key:\n78\t            return \"\"\n79\t        media = \"image/png\" if (frame.image_path or \"\").lower().endswith(\".png\") else \"image/jpeg\"\n80\t        body = json.dumps({\n81\t            \"model\": self.model, media, \"data\": b64}},\n84\t                {\"type\": \"text\", \"text\": (question or \"Describe what is visible.\")},\n85\t            ]}],\n86\t        }).encode(\"utf-8\")\n87\t        req = payload = json.loads(resp.read().decode(\"utf-8\"))\n94\t        except (urllib.error.URLError, OSError, ValueError):\n95\t            return \"\"\n96\t        return \"\".join(b.get(\"text\", \"\") This gate makes the cascade doctrine-honest:\n4\t\n5\t  • The tier is DERIVED from the WARDEN oracle (`KernelClassifier` on `vision.frontier.upload` → A2),\n6\t    never self-declared.\n7\t  • Nothing uploads until a VERIFIED owner approval exists that is BOUND to this exact egress — an\n8\t    `egress_token = sha256(frame.sha256 | question)`. An approval of a different egress (a replay)\n9\t    does not match `target_seq` and does not authorize the upload.\n10\t  • Absent approval, the egress is QUEUED (an A2 proposal recorded on the spine) and the frontier\n11\t    reading is WITHHELD; the local (on-box) reading still stands.\n12\t\n13\tReuses the hardened signed `ApprovalQueue` verification (`verify_approval`) — the same fail-closed\n14\towner-key check the mesh already trusts.\"\"\"\n15\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n16\t\n17\tfrom ..agents.approvals import SIGNAL as _APPROVAL_SIGNAL\n18\tfrom ..agents.approvals import verify_approval\n19\tfrom ..reuse import sha256_hex\n20\t\n21\tEGRESS_SIGNAL = \"vision.egress\"\n22\tFRONTIER_TOOL = \"vision.frontier.upload\"   # classified A2 by the WARDEN oracle (contains \"upload\")\n23\t\n24\t\n25\tdef egress_token(frame_sha256: str, question: str) -> str:\n26\t    \"\"\"A stable id binding an approval to exactly this (frame, question) upload.\"\"\"\n27\t    return sha256_hex(f\"{frame_sha256}|{question or ''}\".encode(\"utf-8\"))\n28\t\n29\t\n30\tdef egress_approved(store, seq: int, token: str, trusted_pubkey) -> bool:\n31\t    \"\"\"True iff `seq` is an egress request bound to `token` AND carries a VERIFIED owner approval.\n32\t    Fail-closed: wrong token, no approval, denied, or an approval of a different seq → False.\"\"\"\n33\t    rec = store.get(seq)\n34\t    if rec is None or rec.payload.get(\"signal\") != EGRESS_SIGNAL or rec.payload.get(\"egress_token\") != token:\n35\t        return False\n36\t    for r in store.iter_records(since_seq=seq):\n37\t        p = r.payload\n38\t        if (p.get(\"signal\") == _APPROVAL_SIGNAL and p.get(\"target_seq\") == seq\n39\t                and p.get(\"approval\") == \"approved\" and verify_approval(r, trusted_pubkey)):\n40\t            return True\n41\t    return False\n42\t"}]},"uuid":"31a2ff3c-500b-4a13-88cd-c68baa05ca60","timestamp":"2026-07-18T18:05:33.289Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"07034294-83ba-4fc8-a2a3-39a3e20f52c6","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Ceiling A1 (observe; writes only event records).\n3\t\n4\tTHE DISCIPLINE (serve-the-quote, reused from SCHOLAR): the frame's captured OCR TEXT is the\n5\tauthoritative content of the answer — verbatim, what the OCR/accessibility layer read off the\n6\towner's screen. The VLM's visual reading is ADVISORY. An object the VLM names is a LEAD, promoted to\n7\ta GROUNDED claim only if the OCR corroborates it (`veracity.corroborate`) — so a divergent or\n8\tfabricated reading is never presented as what is on the screen.\n9\t\n10\tCASCADE (WS-A): the local reader (`MoondreamVision`, on-box, A0) runs freely; the FRONTIER reader\n11\tuploads private bytes and is gated by `Perceptor.frontier` — classified A2 via the WARDEN oracle and\n12\twithheld until a verified owner approval bound to that exact egress exists.\n13\t\n14\tAmbient vision (C6) is OPT-IN: `ambient_watch` establishes a baseline then escalates only on a\n15\tPERCEPTUAL change (`delta.changed` over the OCR token set, not raw byte-identity). Unchanged frames\n16\tnever leave the machine.\"\"\"\n17\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n18\t\n19\tfrom typing import List, Optional\n20\t\n21\tfrom ..agents.base import Agent, AgentResult, Proposal, Tier\n22\tfrom .capture import Frame\n23\tfrom .delta import changed\n24\tfrom .veracity import corroborate\n25\tfrom .vision import VisionModel\n26\t\n27\t# Section headers rendered at COLUMN 0. Captured screen text is guard-prefixed (see below) so it can\n28\t# never occupy column 0 — therefore an EXACT-LINE match on these headers is an unforgeable boundary,\n29\t# even when attacker-controlled screen content contains the header string verbatim (red-pen REDPEN-P5-2).\n30\tAUTHORITATIVE_HEADER = \"## On-screen text (authoritative — captured verbatim from the frame)\"\n31\tCORROBORATED_HEADER = \"## Corroborated objects (VLM leads confirmed verbatim by the captured text)\"\n32\tADVISORY_HEADER = \"## Model's visual reading (ADVISORY — a guess about the image, NOT verified against captured text)\"\n33\t_GUARD = \"  │ \"   # every captured line starts here → it can never impersonate a column-0 header\n34\t\n35\t\n36\tdef compose_perception(question: str, frame: Frame, reading: str,\n37\t                       grounded: Optional[List[dict]] = None) -> str:\n38\t    \"\"\"Serve the captured text as authoritative; corroborated objects (each with a verbatim OCR\n39\t    quote) as grounded; the VLM reading as ADVISORY. Never merge them. The boundary is the column-0\n40\t    header line — unforgeable because every captured line is guard-prefixed.\"\"\"\n41\t    lines = [f\"# Perception — {question or '(observe)'}\", \"\"]\n42\t    captured = (frame.text or \"\").strip()\n43\t    if captured:\n44\t        lines.append(AUTHORITATIVE_HEADER)\n45\t        for ln in captured.splitlines():\n46\t            if ln.strip():\n47\t                lines.append(f\"{_GUARD}{ln.rstrip()}\")   # guard-prefixed: cannot forge the boundary\n48\t        lines.append(f\"\\n(frame: {frame.kind}, sha256 {frame.sha256[:12]}, {len(captured)} chars captured)\")\n49\t    else:\n50\t        lines.append(\"## No text captured from the frame\")\n51\t        lines.append(f\"(frame: {frame.kind}, sha256 {frame.sha256[:12]}, image-only — nothing OCR-grounded to serve)\")\n52\t    if grounded:\n53\t        lines.append(\"\")\n54\t        lines.append(CORROBORATED_HEADER)\n55\t        for g in grounded:\n56\t            lines.append(f\"{_GUARD}'{g['mention']}' — corroborated by on-screen text: \\\"{g['quote']}\\\"\")\n57\t    lines.append(\"\")\n58\t    lines.append(ADVISORY_HEADER)\n59\t    lines.append(f\"- {reading.strip() if reading and reading.strip() else '(no reading available)'}\")\n60\t    return \"\\n\".join(lines)\n61\t\n62\t\n63\tclass Perceptor(Agent):\n64\t    name = \"PERCEPTION\"\n65\t    mandate = \"answer screen/camera queries from captured ground truth; VLM reading is advisory\"\n66\t    ceiling = Tier.A1\n67\t\n68\t    def _emit(self, question: str, frame: Frame, reading: str, *, source_model: str,\n69\t              extra: Optional[dict] = None) -> AgentResult:\n70\t        \"\"\"Build + dispatch the A0 perception event (shared by the local and frontier paths). The\n71\t        one-line summary NEVER serves a bare VLM reading as fact (red-pen RP-PERCEPT-01).\"\"\"\n72\t        grounded, leads = corroborate(reading, frame.text)\n73\t        captured = frame.text.strip()\n74\t        if captured:\n75\t            summary = captured[:120]\n76\t        elif reading.strip():\n77\t            summary = f\"(unverified {source_model} reading) {reading.strip()[:100]}\"\n78\t        else:\n79\t            summary = f\"({frame.kind} image, no text)\"\n80\t        payload = {\n81\t            \"signal\": \"perception\", \"subject\": question or \"observe\", \"summary\": summary,\n82\t            \"text\": compose_perception(question, frame, reading, grounded),\n83\t            \"frame_kind\": frame.kind, \"frame_sha256\": frame.sha256,\n84\t            \"captured_text\": frame.text,                    # authoritative ground truth\n85\t            \"vision_reading_advisory\": reading,             # advisory only\n86\t            \"grounded_objects\": grounded, \"advisory_leads\": leads,\n87\t            \"grounded\": bool(captured), \"source_model\": source_model,\n88\t        }\n89\t        if extra:\n90\t            payload.update(extra)\n91\t        return self._dispatch([Proposal(\"event\", payload, Tier.A0)])   # observe → A0, auto\n92\t\n93\t    def perceive(self, question: str, frame: Frame, *, vision: Optional[VisionModel] = None) -> AgentResult:\n94\t        \"\"\"On-box perception (A0). `vision` is the LOCAL reader (MoondreamVision) or None/a double.\"\"\"\n95\t        reading = \"\"\n96\t        if vision is not None:\n97\t            try:\n98\t                reading = vision.describe(frame, question) or \"\"\n99\t            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — a failing VLM yields no reading, never a crash/guess\n100\t                reading = \"\"\n101\t        return self._emit(question, frame, reading, source_model=\"local\")\n102\t\n103\t    def frontier(self, question: str, frame: Frame, *, vision: VisionModel, classifier=None,\n104\t                 trusted_pubkey=None, approved_seq: Optional[int] = None) -> AgentResult:\n105\t        \"\"\"Frontier perception, EGRESS-GATED. The upload (`vision.describe`) runs ONLY when\n106\t        `approved_seq` names a verified owner approval bound to this exact (frame, question) egress.\n107\t        Otherwise the egress is QUEUED (A2) and NOTHING is uploaded.\"\"\"\n108\t        from ..agents.kernel_classify import KernelClassifier\n109\t        from ..governor.identity import owner_pubkey\n110\t        from .egress import EGRESS_SIGNAL, FRONTIER_TOOL, egress_approved, egress_token\n111\t        classifier = classifier or KernelClassifier()\n112\t        tp = trusted_pubkey if trusted_pubkey is not None else owner_pubkey()\n113\t        token = egress_token(frame.sha256, question)\n114\t        tier = classifier.classify(FRONTIER_TOOL)   # A2 by design (contains \"upload\") — DERIVED, not declared\n115\t\n116\t        if approved_seq is not None and egress_approved(self.store, approved_seq, token, tp):\n117\t            reading = \"\"\n118\t            try:\n119\t                reading = vision.describe(frame, question) or \"\"   # the UPLOAD — only after verified approval\n120\t            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n121\t                reading = \"\"\n122\t            res = self._emit(question, frame, reading, source_model=\"frontier\",\n123\t                             extra={\"egress_approved_seq\": approved_seq})\n124\t            res.notes.append(f\"frontier egress APPROVED (seq {approved_seq}, {tier.label()}) — uploaded + served advisory\")\n125\t            return res\n126\t\n127\t        # no verified approval → QUEUE the egress; upload NOTHING. The tier is DERIVED from the oracle\n128\t        # (A2 for \"...upload\"; A3 if the kernel is unreachable → even more gated) and A2/A3 > ceiling\n129\t        # A1 ⇒ the governor queues it. Nothing uploads on this path.\n130\t        res = self._dispatch([Proposal(\"event\", {\n131\t            \"signal\": EGRESS_SIGNAL, \"subject\": f\"frontier vision egress (frame {frame.sha256[:12]})\",\n132\t            \"summary\": \"frontier vision egress requested — upload WITHHELD pending owner approval\",\n133\t            \"egress_token\": token, \"frame_sha256\": frame.sha256, \"question\": question,\n134\t        }, tier)])\n135\t        res.notes.append(\"frontier egress QUEUED — NO image uploaded; `sigil approve <seq>` then re-run \"\n136\t                         \"`perceive --frontier --approved <seq>`\")\n137\t        return res\n138\t\n139\t    def ambient_watch(self, frames: List[Frame], *, vision: Optional[VisionModel] = None) -> tuple:\n140\t        \"\"\"Opt-in ambient loop (C6). Establish a baseline, then ESCALATE only on a PERCEPTUAL change\n141\t        (`delta.changed` — OCR-token-set divergence, so lighting jitter with the same on-screen text\n142\t        is not a change). Returns (escalation_count, [AgentResult]); emits indicator start/stop\n143\t        markers; unchanged frames produce nothing (they never leave the machine).\"\"\"\n144\t        self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"agent\", actor=self.name,\n145\t                          payload={\"signal\": \"perception.ambient\", \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\",\n146\t                                   \"summary\": \"ambient watch STARTED (indicator lit — opt-in)\"})\n147\t        last: Optional[Frame] = None\n148\t        escalations: List[AgentResult] = []\n149\t        for fr in frames:\n150\t            if last is None:\n151\t                last = fr                      # baseline: no escalation, nothing leaves the machine\n152\t                continue\n153\t            if not changed(last, fr):\n154\t                continue                       # no meaningful change → suppressed\n155\t            last = fr\n156\t            escalations.append(self.perceive(\"(ambient: scene changed)\", fr, vision=vision))\n157\t        self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"agent\", actor=self.name,\n158\t                          payload={\"signal\": \"perception.ambient\", \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\",\n159\t                                   \"summary\": f\"ambient watch STOPPED — {len(escalations)} escalation(s)\"})\n160\t        return len(escalations), escalations\n161\t"}]},"uuid":"c61c2ee8-2f4e-4128-adbf-b3bfc9012230","timestamp":"2026-07-18T18:05:33.674Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"2a11ceb6-b642-4985-b4db-f5d67532d974","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"8054341b-b2f6-4df4-924b-bbc702858312","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"ffbb8a8a-4bb8-4c99-a79e-9ed4dd97a041","agentId":"afc68b33f10efb8e1","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01JenpcTdESDegEQdHfbhFRS","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Perception veracity (Phase 7, WS-A V-iii) — grounded object CLAIMS vs advisory LEADS. A VLM's\n2\tobject list (\"a Firefox window, a laptop, a coffee mug\") is a set of advisory LEADS. A lead is\n3\tpromoted to a GROUNDED claim only if it is corroborated by an INDEPENDENT grounded signal — the\n4\tframe's authoritative OCR `captured_text`: a mention grounds iff it appears verbatim as a salient\n5\ttoken in the captured text. A grounded claim is phrased as corroboration (\"corroborated by on-screen\n6\ttext 'Firefox'\") and carries the verbatim OCR span — never \"there is physically a Firefox.\" This\n7\tmirrors CRUCIBLE's oracle/veracity discipline: the model advises, an independent ground-truth signal\n8\tconfirms. Reuses the `consolidate.gate.salient` tokenizer so the corroboration rule is identical to\n9\tthe memory gate's.\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\timport re\n13\t\n14\tfrom ..consolidate.gate import salient\n15\t\n16\t\n17\tdef _span(token: str, text: str) -> str:\n18\t    \"\"\"The real (case-preserving) OCR substring that corroborates a lowercased token.\"\"\"\n19\t    m = re.search(re.escape(token), text, re.IGNORECASE)\n20\t    return m.group(0) if m else token\n21\t\n22\t\n23\tdef corroborate(reading: str, captured_text: str) -> tuple[list[dict], list[str]]:\n24\t    \"\"\"(grounded, leads). `grounded` = VLM-mentioned salient tokens that appear verbatim in the OCR\n25\t    ground truth, each with its real OCR quote; `leads` = the rest of the VLM's salient tokens\n26\t    (advisory, uncorroborated). If there is no captured text, EVERYTHING is a lead (nothing to\n27\t    corroborate against) — an image-only frame can never yield a grounded object claim.\"\"\"\n28\t    cap = salient(captured_text)\n29\t    read = salient(reading)\n30\t    if not cap:\n31\t        return [], sorted(read)\n32\t    grounded = [{\"mention\": t, \"quote\": _span(t, captured_text)} for t in sorted(read) if t in cap]\n33\t    leads = sorted(read - cap)\n34\t    return grounded, leads\n35\t"}]},"uuid":"a6bfd793-1e3b-4bbf-a630-eaadf2b591ce","timestamp":"2026-07-18T18:05:40.411Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"8054341b-b2f6-4df4-924b-bbc702858312","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"2c8b69e0-fde9-4883-8d1c-6ff106b02c83","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"ffbb8a8a-4bb8-4c99-a79e-9ed4dd97a041","agentId":"afc68b33f10efb8e1","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Y4MD3HQgy1oWwSiuHYMFbD","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Perception recall (Phase 7, WS-A V-iv) — \"where did I last see X?\" answered from GROUNDED\n2\tperception history. Scans perception `event` records for the most recent whose authoritative OCR\n3\t`captured_text` contains the subject (all its salient tokens), and serves the VERBATIM OCR span +\n4\tframe ref + timestamp — the owner's own on-screen text, never a paraphrase and never an advisory VLM\n5\tlead. A0 (observe). Reuses the `consolidate.gate` grounding tokenizer + verbatim-span extractor so\n6\trecall grounds exactly like the memory gate.\"\"\"\n7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n8\t\n9\tfrom typing import Optional\n10\t\n11\tfrom ..consolidate.gate import salient\n12\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n13\t\n14\tPERCEPTION_SIGNAL = \"perception\"\n15\t\n16\t\n17\tdef _grounded_line(subject_tokens: set[str], captured: str) -> str:\n18\t    \"\"\"The verbatim OCR LINE that contains all the subject's salient tokens (context around the\n19\t    sighting), or the captured text truncated — always the real bytes, never a paraphrase.\"\"\"\n20\t    for line in captured.splitlines():\n21\t        if line.strip() and subject_tokens <= salient(line):\n22\t            return line.strip()\n23\t    return captured[:200]\n24\t\n25\t\n26\tdef recall(store: SpineStore, subject: str) -> Optional[dict]:\n27\t    \"\"\"The most recent grounded sighting of `subject`, or None. Grounded = every salient token of the\n28\t    subject appears in that frame's captured OCR text (the authoritative ground truth).\"\"\"\n29\t    subj = salient(subject)\n30\t    if not subj:\n31\t        return None\n32\t    latest = None\n33\t    for r in store.iter_records():\n34\t        if r.kind != \"event\" or r.payload.get(\"signal\") != PERCEPTION_SIGNAL:\n35\t            continue\n36\t        captured = r.payload.get(\"captured_text\") or \"\"\n37\t        if subj <= salient(captured):        # all subject tokens present in the real OCR\n38\t            latest = r                        # seq-ascending iteration → last match is most recent\n39\t    if latest is None:\n40\t        return None\n41\t    captured = latest.payload.get(\"captured_text\") or \"\"\n42\t    return {\n43\t        \"seq\": latest.seq, \"entry_hash\": latest.entry_hash, \"when\": latest.ts,\n44\t        \"frame_sha256\": latest.payload.get(\"frame_sha256\"),\n45\t        \"quote\": _grounded_line(subj, captured),   # verbatim OCR line (never a paraphrase)\n46\t    }\n47\t"}]},"uuid":"f7898f1a-baba-4afb-9a77-51513f3944d9","timestamp":"2026-07-18T18:05:40.912Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"2c8b69e0-fde9-4883-8d1c-6ff106b02c83","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"f7860603-1cd3-4e28-996b-c1371b66fdc3","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"ffbb8a8a-4bb8-4c99-a79e-9ed4dd97a041","agentId":"afc68b33f10efb8e1","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01MM28nNDciLKTVYmgKEmUvM","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Ambient change-detection delta (Phase 7, WS-A V-v). The Phase-5 ambient loop escalated on raw\n2\tbyte-identity (`frame.sha256` inequality), which fires on lighting jitter and misses nothing. This\n3\treplaces it with a PERCEPTUAL delta over the already-captured OCR text: two frames differ only if\n4\ttheir salient-token sets diverge beyond a threshold — so re-rendered/jittered frames with the same\n5\ton-screen text are NOT a change, and a meaningful text shift IS. Falls back to byte-identity when\n6\tneither frame carries OCR text. Cheap, on-box, deterministic. Reuses `consolidate.gate.salient`.\"\"\"\n7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n8\t\n9\tfrom ..consolidate.gate import salient\n10\tfrom .capture import Frame\n11\t\n12\t\n13\tdef changed(prev: Frame, cur: Frame, *, min_token_delta: float = 0.15) -> bool:\n14\t    \"\"\"True iff `cur` is a meaningful change from `prev`. Identical bytes → never a change. With OCR\n15\t    text on either side, compares salient-token sets (Jaccard distance ≥ threshold → change); with no\n16\t    text on either side, falls back to byte-identity.\"\"\"\n17\t    if prev is None:\n18\t        return True\n19\t    if prev.sha256 == cur.sha256:\n20\t        return False                          # identical capture → nothing changed\n21\t    a, b = salient(prev.text), salient(cur.text)\n22\t    if not a and not b:\n23\t        return prev.sha256 != cur.sha256      # no text to compare → byte-identity (already differ)\n24\t    union = a | b\n25\t    if not union:\n26\t        return False\n27\t    jaccard_distance = 1.0 - (len(a & b) / len(union))\n28\t    return jaccard_distance >= min_token_delta\n29\t"}]},"uuid":"481d8a4b-868c-4290-af20-2d06f05b8490","timestamp":"2026-07-18T18:05:41.375Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"f7860603-1cd3-4e28-996b-c1371b66fdc3","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"e8dac534-cda8-4721-b3e2-c337c798301f","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"ffbb8a8a-4bb8-4c99-a79e-9ed4dd97a041","agentId":"afc68b33f10efb8e1","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01T4v1xb99qZASYVKVKrovRJ","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Capture backends (SIGIL §8). A `Frame` is the immutable record of one capture: the image bytes'\n2\tsha256 (integrity), the OCR/accessibility TEXT (the GROUND TRUTH a query is answered from), and a\n3\tpath to the image. Real backends shell out to whatever is installed (screenshot tool + tesseract,\n4\tv4l2/ffmpeg); every backend returns `None` on any failure — a missing camera is no capture, never a\n5\tfabricated one (same posture as SCHOLAR.read_source). `StaticFrame` is the deterministic test double.\n6\t\n7\tHONEST GAPS: headless hosts often lack a screenshot tool / tesseract / a camera, so the real\n8\tbackends degrade to `None` or an image-only Frame (text=\"\"). The richest real screen source is the\n9\tOS accessibility tree (C4); it is not available on a headless box and is left as a documented seam.\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\timport shutil\n13\timport subprocess\n14\timport tempfile\n15\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n16\tfrom pathlib import Path\n17\tfrom typing import Optional\n18\t\n19\tfrom ..reuse import sha256_hex\n20\t\n21\t_SCREENSHOT_TOOLS = (\n22\t    (\"scrot\", [\"scrot\", \"-o\"]),\n23\t    (\"gnome-screenshot\", [\"gnome-screenshot\", \"-f\"]),\n24\t    (\"spectacle\", [\"spectacle\", \"-b\", \"-n\", \"-o\"]),\n25\t    (\"import\", [\"import\", \"-window\", \"root\"]),   # ImageMagick\n26\t)\n27\t\n28\t\n29\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n30\tclass Frame:\n31\t    kind: str                       # \"screen\" | \"camera\"\n32\t    sha256: str                     # integrity of the captured image bytes\n33\t    text: str                       # OCR / accessibility text — the GROUND TRUTH; \"\" if none\n34\t    image_path: Optional[str] = None\n35\t    width: int = 0\n36\t    height: int = 0\n37\t\n38\t    @classmethod\n39\t    def from_image(cls, kind: str, image_path: str, *, text: str = \"\") -> \"Frame\":\n40\t        data = Path(image_path).read_bytes()\n41\t        return cls(kind=kind, sha256=sha256_hex(data), text=text, image_path=image_path)\n42\t\n43\t\n44\tdef _ocr(image_path: str) -> str:\n45\t    \"\"\"Extract text via tesseract if present; '' otherwise (no OCR is not a failure of capture).\"\"\"\n46\t    if not shutil.which(\"tesseract\"):\n47\t        return \"\"\n48\t    try:\n49\t        proc = subprocess.run([\"tesseract\", image_path, \"stdout\"],\n50\t                              capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)\n51\t        return (proc.stdout or \"\").strip()\n52\t    except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError):\n53\t        return \"\"\n54\t\n55\t\n56\tdef grab_screen() -> Optional[Frame]:\n57\t    \"\"\"Screenshot the current display + OCR it. Returns None if no screenshot tool is available\n58\t    or the grab fails. The accessibility-tree path (richer, C4) is a documented seam, not wired\n59\t    on headless hosts.\"\"\"\n60\t    out = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=\".png\", prefix=\"sigil-screen-\")\n61\t    for name, argv in _SCREENSHOT_TOOLS:\n62\t        if not shutil.which(name):\n63\t            continue\n64\t        try:\n65\t            proc = subprocess.run([*argv, out], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)\n66\t        except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError):\n67\t            continue\n68\t        if proc.returncode == 0 and Path(out).exists() and Path(out).stat().st_size > 0:\n69\t            return Frame.from_image(\"screen\", out, text=_ocr(out))\n70\t    return None\n71\t\n72\t\n73\tdef grab_camera(device: str = \"/dev/video0\") -> Optional[Frame]:\n74\t    \"\"\"Grab a single frame from a v4l2 camera via ffmpeg. Resolution requires a\n46\t    VERIFIED approval; an unsigned/forged/wrong-key approval leaves the item pending (fail-closed).\"\"\"\n47\t    if trusted_pubkey_b64 is None:\n48\t        from ..governor.identity import owner_pubkey\n49\t        trusted_pubkey_b64 = owner_pubkey()\n50\t    resolved = set()\n51\t    queued = {}\n52\t    for r in store.iter_records():\n53\t        p = r.payload\n54\t        if p.get(\"signal\") == SIGNAL and verify_approval(r, trusted_pubkey_b64):\n55\t            resolved.add(p.get(\"target_seq\"))       # honor the SIGNED target, not raw supersedes_id\n56\t        if p.get(\"decision\") == \"queued\" and p.get(\"status\") == _QUEUED_STATUS:\n57\t            queued[r.seq] = r\n58\t    return [r for seq, r in sorted(queued.items()) if seq not in resolved]\n59\t\n60\t\n61\tclass ApprovalError(Exception):\n62\t    pass\n63\t\n64\t\n65\tclass ApprovalQueue:\n66\t    def __init__(self, store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, owner_key=None,\n67\t                 trusted_pubkey_b64: Optional[str] = None):\n68\t        from ..governor.identity import owner_keypair, owner_pubkey\n69\t        self.store = store or SpineStore()\n70\t        self.owner_key = owner_key if owner_key is not None else owner_keypair()\n71\t        # PINNED to the persisted owner identity — never defaulted to the supplied key (RP-APPROVAL-2)\n72\t        self.trusted_pubkey_b64 = trusted_pubkey_b64 if trusted_pubkey_b64 is not None else owner_pubkey()\n73\t\n74\t    def _target(self, seq: int):\n75\t        for r in pending(self.store, self.trusted_pubkey_b64):\n76\t            if r.seq == seq:\n77\t                return r\n78\t        raise ApprovalError(f\"seq {seq} is not a pending approval (already decided, or not queued)\")\n79\t\n80\t    def _decide(self, seq: int, decision: str, *, approver: str, reason: str = \"\") -> int:\n81\t        target = self._target(seq)\n82\t        # the signing key MUST be the trusted owner key — not merely \"some key present\" (RP-APPROVAL-2).\n83\t        if (self.owner_key is None or self.trusted_pubkey_b64 is None\n84\t                or self.owner_key.public_key_b64 != self.trusted_pubkey_b64):\n85\t            raise ApprovalError(\"approval requires the OWNER's signing key (missing or not the trusted key)\")\n86\t        msg = _approval_message(seq, decision, approver)\n87\t        sig = sign(self.owner_key.private_key_b64, msg)\n88\t        payload = {\"signal\": SIGNAL, \"approval\": decision, \"target_seq\": seq, \"target_kind\": target.kind,\n89\t                   \"target_tier\": target.payload.get(\"tier\"), \"approver\": approver, \"reason\": reason,\n90\t                   \"pubkey\": self.trusted_pubkey_b64, \"sig\": sig, \"msg_digest\": sha256_hex(msg),\n91\t                   \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"}\n92\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"governor\", actor=\"OWNER\",\n93\t                                 payload=payload, supersedes_id=seq)\n94\t\n95\t    def approve(self, seq: int, *, approver: str = \"owner\", reason: str = \"\") -> int:\n96\t        return self._decide(seq, \"approved\", approver=approver, reason=reason)\n97\t\n98\t    def deny(self, seq: int, *, approver: str = \"owner\", reason: str = \"\") -> int:\n99\t        return self._decide(seq, \"denied\", approver=approver, reason=reason)\n100\t"}]},"uuid":"c8d33761-d5a4-4249-ad7f-32f5cf5dfeca","timestamp":"2026-07-18T18:05:41.961Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"541429d1-8bf1-48a0-a0bc-508c05e07df9","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Each agent has a MANDATE and an AUTONOMY\n2\tCEILING (A0–A3); everything it does is a `Proposal` carrying a tier. Proposals at or below the\n3\tauto bar (A1) and at or below the agent's ceiling are AUTO-APPLIED (written to the spine);\n4\tanything higher is QUEUED as a pending record a human must approve — never auto-executed.\n5\t\n6\tThe doctrine is enforced STRUCTURALLY, not by discipline: an agent literally cannot take an\n7\texternal-effect action, because no agent has a send/deploy/spend code path. ENVOY, in\n8\tparticular, drafts only — its ceiling is A2 and there is no method that transmits. Agent output\n9\tis provenance-linked spine records, so a brief or a draft is auditable back to what produced it.\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\n13\tfrom enum import IntEnum\n14\tfrom typing import List, Optional\n15\t\n16\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n17\t\n18\tAGENTS_SOURCE = \"agent\"\n19\t\n20\t\n21\tclass Tier(IntEnum):\n22\t    \"\"\"Mirror of the WARDEN tiers (SIGIL §5), ordered so `<=` compares autonomy.\"\"\"\n23\t    A0 = 0   # observe / answer\n24\t    A1 = 1   # reversible internal act (write a report/brief/event) — the AUTO bar\n25\t    A2 = 2   # external-visible / semi-reversible (send, calendar write) — QUEUED\n26\t    A3 = 3   # destructive / financial / security — explicit, never auto\n27\t\n28\t    def label(self) -> str:\n29\t        return self.name\n30\t\n31\t\n32\tAUTO_BAR = Tier.A1  # A0/A1 auto-apply; A2/A3 queue for human approval\n33\t\n34\t\n35\t@dataclass\n36\tclass Proposal:\n37\t    \"\"\"One thing an agent wants to do: emit a record (auto) or take a gated action (queued).\"\"\"\n38\t    kind: str                       # spine record kind (event/finding/brief/interaction/draft/...)\n39\t    payload: dict\n40\t    tier: Tier = Tier.A1\n41\t    parent_id: Optional[int] = None\n42\t    supersedes_id: Optional[int] = None   # this record supersedes an earlier one (e.g. a resolution)\n43\t\n44\t\n45\t@dataclass\n46\tclass AgentResult:\n47\t    agent: str\n48\t    applied: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)     # seqs written (auto)\n49\t    queued: List[dict] = field(default_factory=list)      # proposals held for approval\n50\t    notes: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n51\t\n52\t\n53\tclass Agent:\n54\t    \"\"\"Base agent. Subclasses implement `run()`; the base routes every Proposal through the GOVERNOR\n55\t    (SIGIL §5: kill switch, budgets, promotion — Phase 6) and records the outcome on the spine.\n56\t    Backward compatible: with no kill/cap/promotion the governor reproduces the original gate.\"\"\"\n57\t    name: str = \"AGENT\"\n58\t    mandate: str = \"\"\n59\t    ceiling: Tier = Tier.A1\n60\t\n61\t    def __init__(self, store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, governor=None):\n62\t        self.store = store or SpineStore()\n63\t        if governor is None:\n64\t            from ..governor import Governor\n65\t            governor = Governor(self.store)\n66\t        self.governor = governor\n67\t\n68\t    def run(self) -> AgentResult:\n69\t        raise NotImplementedError\n70\t\n71\t    def _dispatch(self, proposals: List[Proposal]) -> AgentResult:\n72\t        from ..governor import Outcome\n73\t        res = AgentResult(agent=self.name)\n74\t        for p in proposals:\n75\t            effective = max(p.tier, Tier.A0)\n76\t            # promotion scope = the RECORD KIND (the real action written), not a self-asserted label:\n77\t            # a promotion is \"this agent may auto-approve A2 records of this kind\" (red-pen RP-3).\n78\t            decision = self.governor.decide(agent=self.name, tier=effective,\n79\t                                            ceiling=self.ceiling, scope=p.kind)\n80\t            common = {**p.payload, \"agent\": self.name, \"tier\": effective.label(),\n81\t                      \"governor\": decision.reason}\n82\t            if decision.outcome == Outcome.AUTO:\n83\t                seq = self.store.append(kind=p.kind, source=AGENTS_SOURCE, actor=self.name,\n84\t                                        payload={**common, \"decision\": \"auto\"},\n85\t                                        parent_id=p.parent_id, supersedes_id=p.supersedes_id)\n86\t                res.applied.append(seq)\n87\t            elif decision.outcome == Outcome.QUEUE:\n88\t                seq = self.store.append(kind=p.kind, source=AGENTS_SOURCE, actor=self.name,\n89\t                                        payload={**common, \"decision\": \"queued\", \"status\": \"awaiting-approval\"},\n90\t                                        parent_id=p.parent_id, supersedes_id=p.supersedes_id)\n91\t                res.queued.append({\"seq\": seq, \"kind\": p.kind, \"tier\": effective.label(),\n92\t                                   \"subject\": p.payload.get(\"subject\") or p.payload.get(\"to\")})\n93\t            else:  # DENY — kill switch or budget; record the refusal, take no action\n94\t                self.store.append(kind=\"refusal\", source=AGENTS_SOURCE, actor=self.name,\n95\t                                  payload={\"agent\": self.name, \"tier\": effective.label(),\n96\t                                           \"decision\": \"denied\", \"governor\": decision.reason,\n97\t                                           \"of_kind\": p.kind, \"subject\": p.payload.get(\"subject\")},\n98\t                                  parent_id=p.parent_id)\n99\t                res.notes.append(f\"DENIED {p.kind} ({effective.label()}): {decision.reason}\")\n100\t        return res\n101\t"}]},"uuid":"c4328b1b-3a7e-46d3-9b3a-9652791d5429","timestamp":"2026-07-18T18:06:14.803Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"fc4f4f2a-738b-46ee-8573-ba6eafd40900","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"4e37c929-fa87-46f8-96f2-ab7cce20e9a2","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"ffbb8a8a-4bb8-4c99-a79e-9ed4dd97a041","agentId":"afc68b33f10efb8e1","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Ko2zPKAsTT5tHTPAkE33dE","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"The veracity gate — SIGIL's demote-only admission choke point (ported from\n2\tveracity/firewall.py's re-execute-don't-string-trust discipline).\n3\t\n4\tThe gate grounds the QUOTE, and the quote — the verbatim record span — is what becomes the\n5\tserved fact. The model's free-text `statement` is NEVER the authoritative content (a\n6\tred-team re-check proved a token-subset check over the statement is not entailment: an\n7\textractor can drop a negation or reorder words to invert meaning while staying a token\n8\tsubset). By certifying and serving the verbatim quote instead, a fabricated or inverted\n9\tstatement can never be presented as a grounded fact — the owner only ever sees their own words.\n10\t\n11\tA candidate GROUNDS iff:\n12\t  1. it cites ≥1 seq, every cited seq is inside the exact window fed to the extractor;\n13\t  2. its `quote` is verbatim in ≥1 cited record re-fetched from the spine (never the model's copy);\n14\t  3. the quote is SPECIFIC — it carries ≥2 salient (non-stopword) tokens, Unicode-aware, so a\n15\t     trivial common substring grounds nothing.\n16\t\n17\tThe gate can only ever DEMOTE; the model's confidence never enters. Anything that fails is\n18\trecorded honestly as commentary, never as a fact and never dropped.\"\"\"\n19\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n20\t\n21\timport re\n22\t\n23\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n24\tfrom .grounding import UNGROUNDED, ground_tag\n25\tfrom .models import CandidateFact, GateVerdict\n26\t\n27\t_WS = re.compile(r\"\\s+\")\n28\t# Unicode-aware: a token starts with a word char (letter/digit, any script) and may carry\n29\t# internal separators (dates 2026-07-20, versions v1.2, paths a/b). \\w is Unicode by default.\n30\t_TOKEN = re.compile(r\"[^\\W_][\\w'./-]*\", re.UNICODE)\n31\t\n32\t_STOPWORDS = frozenset({\n33\t    \"the\", \"and\", \"for\", \"with\", \"that\", \"this\", \"have\", \"has\", \"had\", \"was\", \"were\", \"are\",\n34\t    \"will\", \"would\", \"should\", \"could\", \"can\", \"but\", \"you\", \"your\", \"our\", \"their\",\n35\t    \"from\", \"into\", \"out\", \"about\", \"then\", \"than\", \"them\", \"they\", \"there\", \"here\",\n36\t    \"what\", \"when\", \"where\", \"which\", \"who\", \"how\", \"all\", \"any\", \"some\", \"get\", \"got\", \"let\",\n37\t    \"let's\", \"lets\", \"actually\", \"just\", \"now\", \"today\", \"yesterday\", \"tomorrow\", \"really\",\n38\t    \"very\", \"more\", \"most\", \"much\", \"many\", \"also\", \"like\", \"want\", \"need\", \"going\", \"gonna\",\n39\t})\n40\t\n41\tMIN_QUOTE_SALIENT = 2      # a quote below this is too trivial to ground a claim\n42\t\n43\t\n44\tdef _norm(text: str) -> str:\n45\t    return _WS.sub(\" \", (text or \"\")).strip().lower()\n46\t\n47\t\n48\tdef salient(text: str) -> set[str]:\n49\t    \"\"\"Unicode-aware salient tokens: ≥3 chars, not a stopword, punctuation-trimmed.\"\"\"\n50\t    out: set[str] = set()\n51\t    for t in _TOKEN.findall((text or \"\").casefold()):\n52\t        t = t.strip(\"._/-'\")\n53\t        if len(t) >= 3 and t not in _STOPWORDS:\n54\t            out.add(t)\n55\t    return out\n56\t\n57\t\n58\tdef _real_span(quote: str, record_text: str) -> str | None:\n59\t    \"\"\"Return the BYTE-verbatim span of `record_text` that `quote` matches (tolerant of\n60\t    whitespace/case differences in the model's copy), so the SERVED fact is the record's own\n61\t    bytes, not the model's transcription. None if not found.\"\"\"\n62\t    words = quote.split()\n63\t    if not words:\n64\t        return None\n65\t    pat = r\"\\s+\".join(re.escape(w) for w in words)\n66\t    m = re.search(pat, record_text, re.IGNORECASE)\n67\t    return m.group(0) if m else None\n68\t\n69\t\n70\tdef admit(cand: CandidateFact, window_seqs: set[int], store: SpineStore) -> GateVerdict:\n71\t    \"\"\"Re-execute the candidate's citation(s) and ground the VERBATIM QUOTE(s). A contradiction\n72\t    must verify ≥2 DISTINCT records (evidence from both sides); every other kind needs ≥1. The\n73\t    served `text` is the record's own byte-verbatim span(s). Any failure → UNGROUNDED.\"\"\"\n74\t    if not cand.source_seqs:\n75\t        return GateVerdict(False, UNGROUNDED, [], \"cites no source records — cannot ground\")\n76\t\n77\t    outside = sorted({s for s in cand.source_seqs if s not in window_seqs})\n78\t    if outside:\n79\t        return GateVerdict(False, UNGROUNDED, [],\n80\t                           f\"cites seq(s) outside the fed window {outside} — fabricated citation\")\n81\t\n82\t    quotes = [q for q in (cand.quotes or (cand.quote,)) if q and q.strip()]\n83\t    if not quotes:\n84\t        return GateVerdict(False, UNGROUNDED, [], \"no quote to verify\")\n85\t\n86\t    verified: set[int] = set()\n87\t    spans: list[str] = []\n88\t    for qq in quotes:\n89\t        if len(salient(qq)) < MIN_QUOTE_SALIENT:\n90\t            continue                                          # a trivial quote grounds nothing\n91\t        qn = _norm(qq)\n92\t        for s in cand.source_seqs:\n93\t            rec = store.get(s)\n94\t            if rec is not None and s not in verified and qn in _norm(rec.text()):\n95\t                verified.add(s)\n96\t                spans.append(_real_span(qq, rec.text()) or qq)\n97\t                break\n98\t    if not verified:\n99\t        return GateVerdict(False, UNGROUNDED, [],\n100\t                           \"no quote is verbatim-and-specific in any cited record — fabricated/trivial quote\")\n101\t\n102\t    need = 2 if cand.kind == \"contradiction\" else 1\n103\t    if len(verified) < need:\n104\t        return GateVerdict(False, UNGROUNDED, [],\n105\t                           f\"a {cand.kind} needs ≥{need} distinct records to verbatim-verify — only {len(verified)} did\")\n106\t\n107\t    vs = sorted(verified)\n108\t    return GateVerdict(True, ground_tag(min(vs)), vs,\n109\t                       f\"grounded: {len(vs)} verbatim record span(s) at seq(s) {vs}\",\n110\t                       text=\" || \".join(spans))\n111\t"}]},"uuid":"1d82f8a8-57a5-4d1e-af50-a9f1bee5954c","timestamp":"2026-07-18T18:06:15.741Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"4e37c929-fa87-46f8-96f2-ab7cce20e9a2","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"6c50347e-e1cb-4368-a107-d0fcc608d562","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"ffbb8a8a-4bb8-4c99-a79e-9ed4dd97a041","agentId":"afc68b33f10efb8e1","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_011PVe62HqeoT3WTu7vcLc8X","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"KernelClassifier (Phase 7, P0.1) — the Python↔Rust WARDEN bridge. The authoritative danger\n2\tclassifier is Rust `kernel/src/tiers.rs::classify` (token-based, danger-first, fail-closed to A3),\n3\tcomposed with the raise-only registry pins in `Warden::decide`. Python's `Governor` otherwise\n4\tTRUSTS a Proposal's declared tier; this bridge lets the mesh DERIVE a tool's tier from that\n5\tfail-closed oracle instead of self-declaring it — so an Operator step or a Vision egress hop is\n6\ttiered by the same code that enforces at the kernel.\n7\t\n8\tConsulting the kernel is a pure A0 observation (`sigil-kernel classify` writes NO action-log\n9\trecord). Any failure — missing binary, timeout, non-zero exit, unparseable output, or an unknown\n10\ttier string — resolves to **A3** (fail-closed to the most-gated tier), mirroring the Rust\n11\tclassifier's own posture: never let a bridge error silently downgrade a dangerous tool.\"\"\"\n12\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n13\t\n14\timport json\n15\timport subprocess\n16\t\n17\tfrom ..voice.dispatch import _default_bin  # reuse the exact kernel-binary resolution\n18\tfrom .base import Tier\n19\t\n20\t_TIER = {\"A0\": Tier.A0, \"A1\": Tier.A1, \"A2\": Tier.A2, \"A3\": Tier.A3}\n21\t\n22\t\n23\tclass KernelClassifier:\n24\t    def __init__(self, kernel_bin: str | None = None, timeout: int = 15):\n25\t        self.kernel_bin = kernel_bin or _default_bin()\n26\t        self.timeout = timeout\n27\t\n28\t    def classify(self, tool: str) -> Tier:\n29\t        \"\"\"Return the WARDEN tier for `tool`. Fail-closed to A3 on ANY error/ambiguity.\"\"\"\n30\t        if not tool or not tool.strip():\n31\t            return Tier.A3\n32\t        try:\n33\t            proc = subprocess.run([self.kernel_bin, \"classify\", tool, \"--json\"],\n34\t                                  capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=self.timeout)\n35\t        except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError):\n36\t            return Tier.A3\n37\t        if proc.returncode != 0:\n38\t            return Tier.A3\n39\t        try:\n40\t            data = json.loads(proc.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])\n41\t            return _TIER.get(str(data.get(\"tier\")), Tier.A3)\n42\t        except (ValueError, IndexError, KeyError, TypeError):\n43\t            return Tier.A3\n44\t"}]},"uuid":"3dd16061-53ae-4426-a778-b74e6b5b9e87","timestamp":"2026-07-18T18:06:15.828Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"6c50347e-e1cb-4368-a107-d0fcc608d562","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"16782b5e-37b0-471e-a855-73038c018fc3","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"ffbb8a8a-4bb8-4c99-a79e-9ed4dd97a041","agentId":"afc68b33f10efb8e1","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01JUSLsrosqhqUG4G9c5pgu4","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Append-only, hash-chained JSONL spine (SIGIL §6.1, D1).\n2\t\n3\tReuses CRUCIBLE's tamper-evident chain verbatim (`sigil.reuse`): each line carries\n4\t`{seq, prev_hash, entry_hash}` where `entry_hash` links prev+cert_digest+seq. The\n5\t`cert_digest` is over the record's CONTENT only (scope/kind/source/actor/payload/\n6\tparent/supersedes) — NOT the wallclock `ts` — so the chain is replay-stable. Appends\n7\tare O(1): read the last line's entry, `append_entry`, write.\n8\t\"\"\"\n9\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n10\t\n11\timport json\n12\timport os\n13\tfrom pathlib import Path\n14\tfrom typing import Any, Iterator\n15\t\n16\tfrom ..config import SCOPE, SPINE_PATH\n17\tfrom ..reuse import ChainEntry, append_entry, build_chain, digest_payload, verify_chain\n18\tfrom .models import SpineRecord, now_iso\n19\t\n20\t\n21\tdef _last_nonempty_line(path: Path) -> str | None:\n22\t    \"\"\"Read the last non-empty line without loading the file (seek-from-end).\"\"\"\n23\t    with path.open(\"rb\") as f:\n24\t        f.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)\n25\t        end = f.tell()\n26\t        if end == 0:\n27\t            return None\n28\t        buf = b\"\"\n29\t        pos = end\n30\t        while pos > 0:\n31\t            step = min(8192, pos)\n32\t            pos -= step\n33\t            f.seek(pos)\n34\t            buf = f.read(step) + buf\n35\t            lines = [ln for ln in buf.split(b\"\\n\") if ln.strip()]\n36\t            if lines and (pos == 0 or buf.count(b\"\\n\") >= 2):\n37\t                return lines[-1].decode(\"utf-8\")\n38\t        lines = [ln for ln in buf.split(b\"\\n\") if ln.strip()]\n39\t        return lines[-1].decode(\"utf-8\") if lines else None\n40\t\n41\t\n42\tclass SpineStore:\n43\t    def __init__(self, path: Path | str = SPINE_PATH) -> None:\n44\t        self.path = Path(path)\n45\t        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n46\t        self._last: ChainEntry | None = self._read_last_entry()\n47\t\n48\t    # --- write --------------------------------------------------------------------\n49\t    def append(\n50\t        self, *, kind: str, source: str, actor: str, payload: dict[str, Any],\n51\t        parent_id: int | None = None, supersedes_id: int | None = None,\n52\t        ts: str | None = None,\n53\t    ) -> int:\n54\t        content = {\n55\t            \"scope\": SCOPE, \"kind\": kind, \"source\": source, \"actor\": actor,\n56\t            \"payload\": payload, \"parent_id\": parent_id, \"supersedes_id\": supersedes_id,\n57\t        }\n58\t        cert_digest = digest_payload(content)  # wallclock-free\n59\t        entry = append_entry([self._last], cert_digest) if self._last else build_chain([cert_digest])[0]\n60\t        record = {\n61\t            \"seq\": entry.seq, **content, \"ts\": ts or now_iso(),\n62\t            \"cert_digest\": cert_digest, \"prev_hash\": entry.prev_hash, \"entry_hash\": entry.entry_hash,\n63\t        }\n64\t        with self.path.open(\"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n65\t            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + \"\\n\")\n66\t        self._last = entry\n67\t        return entry.seq\n68\t\n69\t    # --- read ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n70\t    def iter_records(self, *, since_seq: int = -1) -> Iterator[SpineRecord]:\n71\t        if not self.path.exists():\n72\t            return\n73\t        with self.path.open(encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n74\t            for line in f:\n75\t                line = line.strip()\n76\t                if not line:\n77\t                    continue\n78\t                d = json.loads(line)\n79\t                if d[\"seq\"] > since_seq:\n80\t                    yield SpineRecord.from_dict(d)\n81\t\n82\t    def get(self, seq: int) -> SpineRecord | None:\n83\t        for r in self.iter_records(since_seq=seq - 1):\n84\t            if r.seq == seq:\n85\t                return r\n86\t            if r.seq > seq:\n87\t                break\n88\t        return None\n89\t\n90\t    @property\n91\t    def next_seq(self) -> int:\n92\t        return (self._last.seq + 1) if self._last else 0\n93\t\n94\t    def count(self) -> int:\n95\t        return sum(1 for _ in self.iter_records())\n96\t\n97\t    # --- integrity ----------------------------------------------------------------\n98\t    def entries(self) -> list[ChainEntry]:\n99\t        return [\n100\t            ChainEntry(seq=r.seq, prev_hash=r.prev_hash, cert_digest=r.cert_digest, entry_hash=r.entry_hash)\n101\t            for r in self.iter_records()\n102\t        ]\n103\t\n104\t    def verify(self) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n105\t        \"\"\"Two-layer UNKEYED integrity: (1) BINDING — each record's payload still hashes to its\n106\t        stored cert_digest (catches silent payload edits); (2) CHAIN — the entries link cleanly\n107\t        (catches delete/reorder/entry tamper). This proves internal CONSISTENCY, not authenticity:\n108\t        a naive payload edit fails (1), and a mid-chain digest edit cascades an entry_hash/prev_hash\n109\t        break caught by (2) — BUT a writer who recomputes cert_digest+entry_hash for the tip (no\n110\t        successor to cascade into) or forward-cascades a fork produces a self-consistent chain that\n111\t        passes here. Resistance to a recompute-capable writer is the owner-SIGNED head's job\n112\t        (`checkpoint.verify_checkpoint`, Ed25519 + monotonic last_seq). Use this for corruption/\n113\t        naive-tamper detection; use the signed head for tamper-EVIDENCE.\"\"\"\n114\t        entries: list[ChainEntry] = []\n115\t        for r in self.iter_records():\n116\t            content = {\n117\t                \"scope\": r.scope, \"kind\": r.kind, \"source\": r.source, \"actor\": r.actor,\n118\t                \"payload\": r.payload, \"parent_id\": r.parent_id, \"supersedes_id\": r.supersedes_id,\n119\t            }\n120\t            if digest_payload(content) != r.cert_digest:\n121\t                return False, f\"binding break at seq {r.seq}: payload does not match cert_digest (record tampered)\"\n122\t            entries.append(ChainEntry(seq=r.seq, prev_hash=r.prev_hash, cert_digest=r.cert_digest, entry_hash=r.entry_hash))\n123\t        return verify_chain(entries)\n124\t\n125\t    def _read_last_entry(self) -> ChainEntry | None:\n126\t        line = _last_nonempty_line(self.path) if self.path.exists() else None\n127\t        if not line:\n128\t            return None\n129\t        d = json.loads(line)\n130\t        return ChainEntry(seq=d[\"seq\"], prev_hash=d[\"prev_hash\"], cert_digest=d[\"cert_digest\"], entry_hash=d[\"entry_hash\"])\n131\t"}]},"uuid":"ce6e12b4-4121-4a09-b24b-ee13e65f8f17","timestamp":"2026-07-18T18:06:24.826Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"16782b5e-37b0-471e-a855-73038c018fc3","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"6affc067-ded6-4f99-81d0-9e211b068321","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"ffbb8a8a-4bb8-4c99-a79e-9ed4dd97a041","agentId":"afc68b33f10efb8e1","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01ER5bcNxX2xmh1hZGVWdp2y","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"The Governor (SIGIL §5) — the single decision point the agent dispatch gate consults for EVERY\n2\tproposal. It composes the kill switch, budgets, and promotion policy into one fail-closed verdict:\n3\tAUTO (write it), QUEUE (hold for human approval), or DENY (refuse + log). The order matters and is\n4\tdeliberately conservative: observe is always allowed; a kill halts everything above observe; budget\n5\tis checked before any auto-grant; A2 auto-approves only under an explicit promotion; A3 never autos.\n6\t\n7\tKill/promotion are read FRESH per decision (a mid-run kill halts the rest of the run). Backward\n8\tcompatible: with no kill, no cap, and no promotion, A0/A1≤ceiling → AUTO and A2/A3 → QUEUE, exactly\n9\tas the pre-Phase-6 gate behaved.\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n13\tfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n14\tfrom enum import Enum\n15\tfrom typing import Optional\n16\t\n17\tfrom .budget import BudgetCaps, BudgetLedger\n18\tfrom .killswitch import KillSwitch\n19\tfrom .promotion import PromotionPolicy\n20\t\n21\t\n22\tclass Outcome(Enum):\n23\t    AUTO = \"auto\"\n24\t    QUEUE = \"queue\"\n25\t    DENY = \"deny\"\n26\t\n27\t\n28\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n29\tclass Decision:\n30\t    outcome: Outcome\n31\t    reason: str\n32\t\n33\t\n34\tdef _utc_day() -> str:\n35\t    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).date().isoformat()   # runtime bucketing only (never digested)\n36\t\n37\t\n38\tdef _load_caps() -> BudgetCaps:\n39\t    \"\"\"Optional per-agent caps from ~/.sigil/budgets.json ({daily_actions, daily_interrupts}).\n40\t    Absent/malformed → uncapped (budgets opt-in; default behavior unchanged).\"\"\"\n41\t    try:\n42\t        import json\n43\t\n44\t        from ..config import SIGIL_HOME\n45\t        f = SIGIL_HOME / \"budgets.json\"\n46\t        if not f.exists():\n47\t            return BudgetCaps()\n48\t        d = json.loads(f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n49\t        return BudgetCaps(daily_actions=d.get(\"daily_actions\"), daily_interrupts=d.get(\"daily_interrupts\"))\n50\t    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):\n51\t        return BudgetCaps()\n52\t\n53\t\n54\tclass Governor:\n55\t    def __init__(self, store, *, caps: Optional[BudgetCaps] = None, day_iso: Optional[str] = None,\n56\t                 owner_key=None, trusted_pubkey: Optional[str] = None):\n57\t        from .identity import owner_keypair, owner_pubkey\n58\t        self.store = store\n59\t        ok = owner_key if owner_key is not None else owner_keypair()\n60\t        tp = trusted_pubkey if trusted_pubkey is not None else owner_pubkey()\n61\t        self.kill = KillSwitch(store, owner_key=ok, trusted_pubkey=tp)\n62\t        self.promo = PromotionPolicy(store, owner_key=ok, trusted_pubkey=tp)\n63\t        self.budget = BudgetLedger(store, caps if caps is not None else _load_caps())\n64\t        self._day = day_iso\n65\t\n66\t    def decide(self, *, agent: str, tier, ceiling, scope: Optional[str] = None) -> Decision:\n67\t        from ..agents.base import AUTO_BAR, Tier\n68\t        scope = scope or \"*\"\n69\t\n70\t        # A0 observe/read is ALWAYS allowed — even under a kill switch (perception + memory stay alive).\n71\t        if tier <= Tier.A0:\n72\t            return Decision(Outcome.AUTO, \"observe (A0)\")\n73\t\n74\t        # KILL SWITCH: the mesh is halted; nothing above observe may act.\n75\t        if self.kill.is_engaged():\n76\t            return Decision(Outcome.DENY, \"kill switch engaged — agent mesh halted (A0 observe only)\")\n77\t\n78\t        # BUDGET: fail-closed — at cap, deny.\n79\t        over, why = self.budget.over_budget(agent, self._day or _utc_day())\n80\t        if over:\n81\t            return Decision(Outcome.DENY, why)\n82\t\n83\t        # Within the auto bar (A0/A1) and the agent's ceiling → auto, as always.\n84\t        if tier <= AUTO_BAR and tier <= ceiling:\n85\t            return Decision(Outcome.AUTO, f\"within auto bar ({tier.label()})\")\n86\t\n87\t        # A2 may auto-approve ONLY under an explicit per-scope promotion (never for ENVOY).\n88\t        if tier == Tier.A2 and tier <= ceiling and self.promo.is_promoted(agent, scope):\n89\t            return Decision(Outcome.AUTO, f\"A2 auto-approved by promotion ({agent}/{scope})\")\n90\t\n91\t        # Everything else (A2 unpromoted, A3, or above ceiling) queues for explicit human approval.\n92\t        return Decision(Outcome.QUEUE, f\"queued for approval ({tier.label()})\")\n93\t"}]},"uuid":"0d7006b0-7a25-4966-a44a-d28dde15d080","timestamp":"2026-07-18T18:06:35.937Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"6affc067-ded6-4f99-81d0-9e211b068321","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}
{"parentUuid":"57d02ab1-86a0-4a21-8a5d-67a20f32467c","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"ffbb8a8a-4bb8-4c99-a79e-9ed4dd97a041","agentId":"afc68b33f10efb8e1","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_018SvBtiH3KB5oz8Hf98cHF6","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Per-scope promotion policy (SIGIL §5). An owner may promote a specific (agent, scope) so its A2\n2\tproposals auto-approve instead of queuing — EXCEPT ENVOY, which has NO promotion path (§4.6). A3\n3\tnever promotes.\n4\t\n5\tAUTHENTICATED (Phase 6 red-pen RP-2/RP-4): a grant/revoke is meaningless unless SIGNED by the owner\n6\tkey and verified against the persisted trusted pubkey. `is_promoted` ignores any grant that does not\n7\tverify — so a forged grant written by a prompt-injected agent via `self.store` grants nothing. The\n8\tgate scope is the proposal's RECORD KIND (the real action written), not a self-asserted label\n9\t(RP-3), so a promotion is \"agent X may auto-approve A2 records of kind K.\" \"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\tfrom typing import Optional\n13\t\n14\tfrom .authn import signed_payload, verify_signed\n15\tfrom .identity import owner_keypair, owner_pubkey\n16\t\n17\tSIGNAL = \"governor.promotion\"\n18\tNO_PROMOTION_AGENTS = frozenset({\"ENVOY\"})   # structural: outbound stays human-gated forever (§4.6)\n19\t_CORE = (\"signal\", \"state\", \"agent\", \"scope\")\n20\t\n21\t\n22\tclass PromotionPolicy:\n23\t    def __init__(self, store, *, owner_key=None, trusted_pubkey: Optional[str] = None):\n24\t        self.store = store\n25\t        self.owner_key = owner_key if owner_key is not None else owner_keypair()\n26\t        self.trusted_pubkey = trusted_pubkey if trusted_pubkey is not None else owner_pubkey()\n27\t\n28\t    def grant(self, agent: str, scope: str = \"*\"):\n29\t        if agent in NO_PROMOTION_AGENTS:\n30\t            self.store.append(kind=\"refusal\", source=\"governor\", actor=\"WARDEN\",\n31\t                              payload={\"signal\": SIGNAL, \"decision\": \"refused\", \"agent\": agent,\n32\t                                       \"scope\": scope, \"tier\": \"A0\",\n33\t                                       \"reason\": f\"{agent} has no promotion path (SIGIL §4.6) — outbound stays human-gated\"})\n34\t            return None\n35\t        core = {\"signal\": SIGNAL, \"state\": \"granted\", \"agent\": agent, \"scope\": scope}\n36\t        payload = {**signed_payload(core, self.owner_key), \"by\": \"owner\", \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"}\n37\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"governor\", actor=\"WARDEN\", payload=payload)\n38\t\n39\t    def revoke(self, agent: str, scope: str = \"*\") -> int:\n40\t        core = {\"signal\": SIGNAL, \"state\": \"revoked\", \"agent\": agent, \"scope\": scope}\n41\t        payload = {**signed_payload(core, self.owner_key), \"by\": \"owner\", \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"}\n42\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"governor\", actor=\"WARDEN\", payload=payload)\n43\t\n44\t    def is_promoted(self, agent: str, scope: str = \"*\") -> bool:\n45\t        if agent in NO_PROMOTION_AGENTS:\n46\t            return False                          #
